summary: The prepared base already contains the issue-specific solution merged upstream as PR #31311 (commit 1843384c7a59b8a904f4bdadef51f10cbcaa017b): the LongCat ScMoE dense branch gathers scattered hidden/residual rows before self_attn[1], then reconciles branch row counts. This change adds the missing regression coverage and verifies the reported scattered-hidden/full-positions reshape failure plus the corrected boundary behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Five focused cases: active-EP TP=2 gathers before second attention; the legacy no-gather path reproduces a RoPE token-count RuntimeError; no-backend and TP=1 boundaries remain unchanged; row alignment gathers and rank-slices correctly. Raw output: reports/j-dee30f6c3ca9/raw/pytest.log

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), a scattered q_pe tensor failed the full-position RoPE view as reported; the existing alignment path produced full rows, a valid RoPE view, correct rank-local slicing, and max absolute error 0.0 against an independent torch.cat reference. Raw output: reports/j-dee30f6c3ca9/raw/gfx950_alignment.log
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, AST, and registered-test metadata checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-dee30f6c3ca9/raw/precommit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The deterministic tensor-level probe ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, reported gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, reproduced the invalid legacy reshape, and validated corrected aligned values with max_abs_error=0.0.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported 4x H200 tp16/ep16 PD-disaggregated DeepEP deployment could not be reproduced.
LongCat-2.0-FP8 weights were not available; model semantic accuracy and the complete serving path remain unverified here.
The GPU probe validates the token-shape/alignment mechanism, not a live multi-rank all-gather or DeepEP/UCCL transport.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
